verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI exposes message-history APIs that let developers serialize/deserialize conversation state (docs-7, comm-13), which can be persisted to a database to survive across sessions, but there's no built-in long-term memory store, vector recall, or cross-thread memory abstraction — developers must build that persistence layer themselves, and one production user notes 'history across turns... is a lot of glue' (comm-14).
